summary: Fixed the critical bug where detected Node.js path was not being added to the final PATH. The issue was in buildPathsToAdd() - it only processed candidatePaths and npmPrefix, but not all paths in existingPaths. The Node.js directory was added to existingPaths but then ignored during PATH construction. Fixed by including all existingPaths in the final PATH prepending.
current_status: Critical fix applied. Now existingPaths (which contains Node.js) is properly included in final PATH.
next_steps: User must run: npm run build
Test 'Invoke Claude All' - Node.js should now be in PATH
Check logs to see the new detailed PATH construction logging
